raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Fix `NIXLCheckpointEngine.build_topology` for a topology with one rollout worker.

`next_agent_metadata` used a negative slice start. When
`rollout_world_size == 1`, that evaluates to `0`, returning all metadata
instead of no successor metadata and causing `build_process_group` to fail:

    AssertionError: rollout_kwargs[next_agent_metadata] must have length of 1

Use an index relative to `len(metadata)` instead. Topologies with two or more
rollout workers retain the same slice bounds.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Query: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+state%3Aopen+nixl
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`

### Test

- [x] `git show --check`
- [x] Added a unit test.

### API and Usage Example

No API or user-facing usage changes.

### Design & Code Changes

- Replace the negative slice start with `len(metadata) - rollout_world_size + 1`.
- This makes the single-rollout case produce an empty slice before appending the `None` terminator.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting): `pre-commit install && pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always`
- [x] Documentation is not needed; this is an internal topology correction.
- [x] Add the focused unit test above. No CI workflow change is needed.
- [ ] Request CI in `ci-request` once ready.
- [x] Not related to the `recipe` submodule.

+# limitations under the License.
+
+from verl.checkpoint_engine.nixl_checkpoint_engine import NIXLCheckpointEngine
+
+
+def test_build_topology_with_single_rollout_worker():
+    metadata = ["trainer", "rollout"]
+
+    _, rollout_kwargs = NIXLCheckpointEngine.build_topology(
+        actor_wg_world_size=1,
+        rollout_world_size=1,
+        metadata=metadata,
+    )
+
+    assert rollout_kwargs["prev_agent_metadata"] == ["trainer"]
+    assert rollout_kwargs["next_agent_metadata"] == [None]

@@ -300,7 +300,7 @@ def build_topology(cls, actor_wg_world_size: int, rollout_world_size: int, metad
             "rank": list(range(1, rollout_world_size + 1)),
             "world_size": [rollout_world_size + 1] * rollout_world_size,
             "prev_agent_metadata": [metadata[0]] + metadata[-rollout_world_size:-1],
-            "next_agent_metadata": metadata[-rollout_world_size + 1 :] + [None],
+            "next_agent_metadata": metadata[len(metadata) - rollout_world_size + 1 :] + [None],
         }
         return actor_wg_kwargs, rollout_kwargs
